AP Physics (all four subjects) continued on next page

For all four Physics subjects, 
some questions have different 
versions. For these questions 
there’s a page in the booklet 
for each version.   

Q5520/02 

Question 1 

There are four versions of Question 1; you 
will only be answering one version. 

Bluebook will indicate which version to 
answer (J, K, L, or M) and the page 
number in the booklet. 

Make sure you respond in the correct 
space in the booklet.
